resources.string: Keep your spam list the same on all your phones
Keep your spam list and allowed numbers the same on all your phones, using your own Nextcloud. Only those two lists are uploaded, to a folder called UltimatePhone.
Only https addresses are accepted, so your password is never sent unencrypted.
An app password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
Do not use your normal password. In Nextcloud open Settings, Security, Devices and sessions, type a name such as UltimatePhone, choose Create new app password and paste it here.
Optional. You can also do this later in Settings.
Every few hours, and shortly after you change a list, when you are online.
Changes are waiting to be uploaded.
